api.openapi_spec_url: UNVERIFIED (each resource has describe endpoint /resources/11.13.18.05/{resource}/describe; docs publish per-endpoint reference)

scopes_needed_read: Fusion resource scope configured on the IAM confidential application (scope string per Oracle doc configure_oauth, exact value UNVERIFIED)
auth.refresh: Basic auth over SSL, JWT in header, or OAuth 2.0 via OCI IAM identity domain (2-legged or 3-legged); basic auth is simplest but needs a stored integration-user password

access_requirements.partner_program_name: Oracle PartnerNetwork needed only for listing/ test pods; none for calling customer APIs
access_requirements.customer_admin_must_do: Create an integration user with a role that carries the needed Financials REST privileges (e.g. Accounts Receivable/Payables inquiry duties) and, for OAuth, register a confidential application in the Fusion IAM identity domain with grant types and scopes, then send us client ID/secret, pod URL.
access_requirements.time_to_approval: Days to weeks driven by customer IT/security; no vendor approval

sandbox.how_to_get: Only customer test/stage pods; no public sandbox found

rate_limits: UNVERIFIED for ERP REST; docs state REST API timeout of 5 minutes (via search snippet)

events: Business events for outbound integration via Oracle Integration Cloud / ERP Cloud Adapter (module-specific; ERP financial event list UNVERIFIED)

data_objects_to_pull: journals/ledger via BI Publisher or FBDI exports
incremental_sync: q=LastUpdateDate>'{cursor}' filter on resource collections with limit/offset paging; bulk GL via BI Publisher reports or ESS-scheduled exports (not verified on a fetched page)
